decisions.reason: The Demeter yogurt is a close extension of an established, popular range and is still featured two years after launch, so it likely meets aspirations in a growing organic market and gives no trigger for problemistic search.

The mild sliced cheese launched recently, has its own product page, and uses the in-house cheesemaking capability; with industry growth and slack, management would carry it while its results are still uncertain.

The sliced butter cheese fits the core competence and has a dedicated page, but it may overlap with the mild sliced cheese; a slightly higher risk of rationalisation is plausible, yet it is too early to judge it below aspiration.
